idea-plugin.name: Billable
idea-plugin.description:
Run every project on the right Claude account, and always know which one you are on.

Freelancers and consultants often hold a Claude account per client, plus a personal one. Claude Code signs in once per config directory, so it is easy to spend a client's quota on your own project, or lose track of what a session costs. Billable puts the account, the usage and the switch in the status bar.

  • The account in the status bar: the account this folder runs on, the latest session's tokens and cost, and the highest rate-limit usage. It turns amber at 90% of a limit.
  • Switch in one click: the choice is saved per folder, so each project keeps its own account.
  • Cost report by account: what each account, and each folder under it, cost in a month, with CSV export for invoices.
  • The terminal follows: one shell function makes claude in the IDE terminal start on the folder's account.

Works with the companion Claude Code plugin multi-account and shares its setup with the Billable extension for VS Code. Everything stays on your machine. Not affiliated with Anthropic.
